h1.en: concrete pump split piston φ250: sections borrowed from Fire hose
h1.zh: concrete pump split piston φ250：章节借自《Fire hose》

directAnswer.en: For concrete pump split piston φ250, copy the printed fragments and ignore any urge to borrow a figure from Fire hose. Fire hose only lends its headings. A φ250 split piston is one outer-diameter row on the Xingtai split-piston page. It is sold as a set. The materials printed for this row are rubber only. No published pump page assigns φ250 to a model.
directAnswer.zh: 写concrete pump split piston φ250时，只抄已印片段，不要从来源页《Fire hose》借数字。《Fire hose》只出借标题。 φ250 分体活塞是邢台分体活塞页上的一条外径。按套供货。这一行印出的材料是只有橡胶。没有任何已公布泵页把 φ250 指定到某一型号。

body.en: Read “History” as the source author’s section, not as a Pinjin test result. The sentence that follows is the printed fragment. The split piston is a replacement set for S-valve concrete pumps, supplied from Xingtai by Hebei Pinjin Machinery. The full outer-diameter list is φ150, φ180, φ195, φ200, φ220, φ230, φ250, φ260 and φ280. This note is only the φ250 row, materials: rubber only. Unit: set. The page does not print a compound grade, a hardness, or a service life. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. The integral-piston page is a different part. Where the same φ250 also appears there, it is still not a pump-model assignment. Electric 20's 80 mm figure is a pipe inner diameter, not a piston outer diameter. No neighbouring page’s figure is copied onto this row.
body.zh: 把“历史”读成来源作者的分节，不要读成品锦的试验结果。后面跟的是已印片段。 分体活塞是河北品锦机械从邢台供应的 S 阀混凝土泵替换套件。全部外径是 φ150, φ180, φ195, φ200, φ220, φ230, φ250, φ260 and φ280。本文只写 φ250 这一行，材料：只有橡胶。单位：套。页面没有印胶料牌号、硬度或寿命。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 整体活塞是另一件配件。若同一个 φ250 也出现在那边，仍然不是泵型号的指定。电动20的 80 mm 是输送管内径，不是活塞外径。 不把旁边那一页的数字抄到这一行。

body.en: The source page divides this subject at “Modern usage”. The words under that heading, in this note, stay inside the Xingtai wording already printed. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Write split piston, φ250, the material row (rubber only), and the quantity in sets. Leave life and pump model blank if the machine check is not done. A φ250 split piston is one outer-diameter row on the Xingtai split-piston page. It is sold as a set. The materials printed for this row are rubber only. No published pump page assigns φ250 to a model. The outline does not complete a blank.
body.zh: 来源页在“现代用法”处分开叙述。这一节沿用该标题，底下只重复邢台已经印出的说法。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 写明分体活塞、φ250、材料行（只有橡胶）和套数。若还没在机器上核对，寿命和泵型号留空。 φ250 分体活塞是邢台分体活塞页上的一条外径。按套供货。这一行印出的材料是只有橡胶。没有任何已公布泵页把 φ250 指定到某一型号。 大纲补不上空白格子。

body.en: A reader who opens the source page will find “Manufacturing process”. This note keeps the heading and puts the printed fragment beneath it. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. A service life, a replacement-hour figure and a wear-rate table are not printed. Leave that field blank. The outline does not complete a blank.
body.zh: 打开来源页会看到“制造过程”。这篇笔记保留该标题，并把已印片段放在标题下面。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 使用寿命、更换小时和磨损速率都没有印出。这一栏留空。 大纲补不上空白格子。

body.en: “Connections” organises the source article. Organised under it here is catalogue language, unchanged in its figures. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. The page calls them Xingtai replacement wear parts, not OEM parts of other pump brands. Stop when the printed fragment stops.
body.zh: “来源章节：Connections”用来组织来源文章。组织在它下面的，是目录里的说法，数字保持原样。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 页面写的是邢台替换易损件，不是其他泵品牌的原厂件。 印出的片段结束，这句话也结束。
